//: A fixture, not a product: one `webhook` job, `ingest`, that reads the delivered payload `{ entityId, title }` and emits it as a signal on that record through Content.emitSignal. Its manifest declares `ingress: { signature: 'hmac-sha256' }`, so web verifies a delivery before the worker ever sees it. The worker's ingress live test drives it end to end.
name: @spaces/plugin-hooked
